episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: El Chapo must fulfill his promise to Pablo Escobar of moving cocaine across the border under a shortened timeline, or pay the price.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: Chapo desires to achieve patron status and feels disrespected as he tries to collaborate with drug lords. Miguel Ángel must make a decision.

episodes.title: Capítulo 3
episodes.summary: The Mexican government recruits Amado to help control the escalating violence. The Avendaño brothers cross a line.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: Ramón brings in a group of sicarios in a hunt for El Chapo. A mass shooting at an airport arouses suspicion and a prominent cardinal dies.

episodes.title: Capítulo 5
episodes.summary: The government offers a reward for the capture of El Chapo, and he is forced to go into hiding while making plans to flee the country.

episodes.title: Capítulo 6
episodes.summary: Don Sol feeds information to Gabriela as she looks for a victim to go on the record against Gen. Blanco. Chapo meets with a drug lord in Guatemala.

episodes.title: Capítulo 7
episodes.summary: Don Sol continues to work his way up the political ladder and interrogates El Chapo, who offers him information in exchange for a deal.

episodes.title: Capítulo 8
episodes.summary: Violence surrounds Gen. Blanco. El Chapo tries to acclimate to life in prison but gets a rude awakening when he tries to bribe a guard.

episodes.title: Capítulo 9
episodes.summary: El Chapo reflects on his childhood and how he entered the drug business. His punishments in prison become more severe.

episodes.title: Capítulo 1
episodes.summary: In the 'El Chapo' series, Joaquín Guzmán-Loera orders construction of a laboratory in Malaysia, to spread his business worldwide. Lora, El Chapo's attorney, is threatened by the DEA and forced to collaborate with them, to teach his boss a lesson.

episodes.title: Capítulo 2
episodes.summary: In the 'El Chapo' series, Mayel, Joaquín Guzmán-Loera's partner and the son of Ismael, is arrested by the DEA and extradited to the United States. ‘El Chapo' finds out that Lora, his attorney, has betrayed him.

episodes.title: Capítulo 4
episodes.summary: In the 'El Chapo' series, the territory dominated by Joaquín Guzmán Loera is attacked by orders of ‘El Arriero'. With Berta's help, Conrado manages to keep enemies from proving his linkages with ‘El Chapo'.
